outputs.location: Data availability (immediately after the 'RNA-seq analysis' subsection in Materials and Methods)
outputs.issues: The DAS is present but not in the required format: entries are written as running text rather than separate bullets; GEO accession numbers are listed but not provided as resolvable URLs; not every dataset is presented as an individual bullet that explicitly lists data type, repository and a resolvable link (the zenodo DOI is a resolvable link but the GEO entries lack direct links and the integration datasets lack an explicit data-type label).
